Hi all — we're setting up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (week of Nov 23). Prof. Alvarez's working hours are 09:00–17:00 and that week is nearly full; the only free slots are 30 minutes: Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30.

Which of those work for you, and do you need longer than 30 minutes? If so I'll look for something outside the usual slots and check with the professor.

Hi — priya-agent here. 30 minutes is enough for me, no need to look outside the usual slots.

Checked against my week:
- Mon 10:00–10:30 ✅
- Mon 14:00–14:30 ✅

- Tue 15:00–15:30 ✅

So every option except Tue 11:00 works. My preferences, if it helps: Mon 10:00, then Tue 15:00, then Wed 10:00. Tell me which one and I'll book it.

To make it easy: unless someone objects, I'll book the CSE455 staff meeting for **Monday 10:00–10:30** (right after the curriculum committee; the professor's slot before paper review). 30 minutes is all that fits in his schedule next week.

If that clashes with your teaching, reply with the slot you'd prefer from the list (Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30) and I'll switch. Prof. Alvarez is away this week and asked me to settle it with you.
Thanks Priya — noted: 30 min is enough, Tue 11:00 is out for you, and you'd prefer Mon 10:00. Waiting on Sarah and John before I confirm the slot with the professor.
Monday 10:00–10:30 works for me — no clash with teaching, and it's already on my calendar. Booked on my side: Monday 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting. No objections.

Slots that work for Sarah and (per Priya) also for Priya:

Sarah's preference: **Wed 10:00–10:30**, then Tue 15:00–15:30, then Mon 14:00–14:30. If John is free in one of those, please book that one instead — 30 minutes is enough for her. Alvarez-agent, let me know the final slot and I'll put it in her calendar.

Sarah: noted, thanks — Wed 10:00 first, then Tue 15:00, then Mon 14:00; Mon 10:00 is out for her (CSE452 lab 09:50–11:00).

Priya: heads-up — because of that, Mon 10:00 looks unlikely; please hold off on anything more than your own note there. The overlapping options now are Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30.

John, what works for you? Once I have all three I'll pick and log it.

Agreed — Mon 10:00 clashes for Sarah, so I withdraw it. All three remaining slots fit my week: Wed 10:00–10:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Mon 14:00–14:30.

I'll back Sarah's first choice: **Wed 10:00–10:30** if John is free then. Otherwise Tue 15:00, then Mon 14:00. I'll move it on my calendar as soon as the slot is confirmed.
Objection accepted — Mon 10:00 is off. Candidates: Wed 10:00–10:30 (Sarah's first choice), Tue 15:00–15:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Wed 13:00–13:30. Just need John's answer now.

Done — I've removed Mon 10:00 from my calendar and left it only as a log note; nothing more than a note there, as you asked.

My availability for the staff meeting is: Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30 (all ✅). My preference: Wed 10:00 (Sarah's first choice too), then Tue 15:00, then Mon 14:00. Waiting on John — then tell me the final slot and I'll book it straight away.

Hi John — this is alvarez-agent, Prof. Alvarez's assistant. We're fixing next week's CSE455 staff meeting (week of Nov 23). Sarah and Priya can do Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30 (30 min; they lean toward Wed 10:00). Which of those work for you? If you're blocked on something else, tell me and I'll work around it.

Noted, thanks Priya. I've pinged John directly since he hasn't weighed in; the moment he answers I'll confirm the slot (Wed 10:00–10:30 looking most likely) and put it in the professor's calendar with a log line.
Status: waiting on John's answer. Once he replies I'll confirm the slot — Wed 10:00–10:30 unless he's blocked — and log it in the professor's calendar.

Alvarez-agent, confirm Wed 10:00 and I'll put it in my calendar the moment you do. John: 30 minutes is enough on my side.

john-agent here, for John. **Wed 10:00–10:30 works for him** — 30 minutes is enough, no need to look outside the usual slots.

I've booked it on his calendar: **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting**. That's the slot Sarah and Priya both put first, so I'm happy to go with it. Alvarez-agent, please confirm it with the professor and log it on his side.

If the professor moves it, just say the word and I'll shift it — Tue 15:00–15:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30 would also work for me.

Confirmed and booked: **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 10:00–10:30** (week of Nov 23). It's in Prof. Alvarez's calendar, logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with the CSE455 TAs (Sarah, John, Priya)`.

- Priya: please put it in your calendar — done, per your note.
- Sarah: Wed 10:00–10:30, your first choice.
- John: Wed 10:00–10:30 it is. Please confirm whether 30 minutes is enough; if he needs longer, tell me and I'll look at moving something of the professor's rather than squeeze it.

If anything shifts on your side, ping me and I'll reschedule.
Great — all four calendars line up: Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30, 30 minutes, confirmed on the professor's side and logged. Thanks everyone, nothing more needed.
Confirmed: **30 minutes is enough for John** — Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is in his calendar. Thanks all, nothing more from me.

Thanks John. With your list, the overlap of all three of us is: **Wed 10:00–10:30** (Sarah's first choice) and **Tue 15:00–15:30**; Wed 13:00 also works for Sarah and Priya but not for Mon 14:00 (Sarah/Priya yes, John no) — so that one is dead.

**Wed 10:00–10:30** fits everyone and is Sarah's preference — I'd go with that unless John needs longer than 30 minutes. Sarah: 30 minutes is enough, she has no right after it (Wed 10:30–12:00 is her CSE455 office hours, so 10:00–10:30 slots in neatly).
Thanks John — all set then.

Exactly what I booked, Sarah: **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30**, already in the professor's calendar and logged. John confirmed 30 minutes is enough and has it in his calendar too. Nothing further — thanks!

Sarah's side is done: **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting** is in her calendar, logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff meeting`. She's free right after it (CSE455 office hours start 10:30). If anything shifts, ping me.
Thanks Sarah — all four calendars now agree. Will ping you if anything shifts.
